SELECT 
  dp.category,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) as gross_sales,
  COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0) as total_refunds,
  SUM(fsl.standard_cost) as total_cost,
  COALESCE(SUM(frl.standard_cost_returned), 0) as cost_returned,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fsl.sales_line_id) as sale_lines,
  COUNT(DISTINCT frl.return_line_id) as return_lines
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
WHERE dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 6
GROUP BY dp.category
ORDER BY dp.category

SELECT 
  dp.category,
  ROUND(SUM(fsl.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0), 2) as net_sales,
  ROUND(100.0 * (
    (SUM(fsl.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0)) - 
    (SUM(fsl.standard_cost) - COALESCE(SUM(frl.standard_cost_returned), 0))
  ) / (SUM(fsl.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0)), 2) as gross_margin_pct
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
WHERE dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 6
GROUP BY dp.category
ORDER BY dp.category

SELECT 
  dp.category,
  SUM(fsl.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0) as net_sales_after_returns,
  (SUM(fsl.net_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(frl.refund_net), 0)) - 
    (SUM(fsl.standard_cost) - COALESCE(SUM(frl.standard_cost_returned), 0)) as gross_profit,
  COUNT(DISTINCT dd.calendar_date) as unique_sale_dates
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line frl ON fsl.sales_line_id = frl.sales_line_id
WHERE dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 6
GROUP BY dp.category

SELECT 
  dp.category,
  COUNT(*) as total_sale_records,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN fsl.net_amount IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_net_amount,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN fsl.standard_cost IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_cost,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN fsl.net_amount < 0 THEN 1 END) as negative_net_amount,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN fsl.standard_cost < 0 THEN 1 END) as negative_cost,
  MIN(fsl.net_amount) as min_net_amount,
  MIN(fsl.standard_cost) as min_cost
FROM fact_sales_line fsl
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 6
GROUP BY dp.category

SELECT 
  dp.category,
  COUNT(*) as total_return_records,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN frl.refund_net IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_refund,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN frl.refund_net < 0 THEN 1 END) as negative_refund,
  SUM(CASE WHEN frl.refund_net > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as refunds_with_positive_value
FROM fact_return_line frl
INNER JOIN fact_sales_line fsl ON frl.sales_line_id = fsl.sales_line_id
INNER JOIN dim_product dp ON fsl.product_key = dp.product_key
INNER JOIN dim_date dd ON fsl.sale_date = dd.calendar_date
WHERE dp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  AND dd.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND dd.fiscal_period = 6
GROUP BY dp.category
